assign.title: Dictation to brief: refine.mjs, coverage audit, and an honest check of the tab's relays
assign.outcome:
**Server/refine.mjs turns a dictation into clean, structured and brief rungs, traces every sentence you said, and repairs what it drops. It is on the card beside an audit of the VS Code tab.** Over budget: $47 against $10.

![run C, ask 1 clicked: its source lights up in clean and raw](/framework/ai/2026-09-29/prompt-refine/shots/run-c-1920-click.png)

- [x] raw Whisper text always kept: already true, in Dictate's Raw tab and .claude/prompts (Server/doc/refine.md, ask 1)
- [x] a ladder, each step saved and diffable: raw.txt, clean.md, structured.md, brief.md per run (runs/a, b, c)
- [x] coverage from brief to source: coverage.md, plus flags for new words and hardened words, and a repair round (run C: drops 8 to 1)
- [ ] coverage you can trust: the audit found it misses drops inside long sentences. Next: check per idea, not per sentence
- [x] multi-model refinement: Haiku and Sonnet draft, then collab.mjs or a judge picks; scoreboard in Server/refine-scoreboard.jsonl. Collab added nothing on its one run
- [x] a tool in the skills: new-task, sub-mastermind, every-prompt. The VS Code tab's own skill was handed to mastermind-servex-4
- [x] proven on 3 real dictations: [audit.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-29/prompt-refine/audit.md). The tab dropped 4, 3 and 7 asks and turned doubts into rules, but always passed your raw words along
- [x] on the card: [the card](/framework/ai2/2026/09/29/from-dictation-to-a-brief-with-nothing-l/), with the ladder, a run picker, dropped and flagged rows, and the audit table

Reviewed: 4 fixed, 7 noted ([review.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-29/prompt-refine/review.md)). The view: [/framework/ext/Refine/](/framework/ext/Refine/). Left: a walkthrough, and per-idea coverage. The cost came from two minions that grew to 430k to 470k context across five Servex restarts and polling loops (logged in sub-mastermind/improvements.md).
